claims.text: The included Expo Web screenshots show the phone-width Personal and Shop workspaces, an empty tablet-width Business report workspace, and an invented empty shortlist. They are browser previews captured on 6 November 2026, not native device acceptance.
The historical website screenshot shows a local PayPal Markets concept homepage with a public CoinGecko reference snapshot; the values are not current execution quotes.
The historical market insight screenshot shows local generated commentary based on public seven-day BTC/GBP candle data, not private holdings or personalized investment advice.
The separate Operations screenshots show a disconnected local concept using explicitly invented aggregate and cohort figures. They do not show PayPal internal monitoring or real customer activity.
The two original illustrations are visibly labelled INDEPENDENT CONCEPT and are promotional concept art, not product screenshots.

The visual direction explores market context, manually entered estimates and Channel3 discovery around an existing wallet experience, while keeping customer and fictional management surfaces distinct.

On one Xiaomi Android 15 device, the PayPal Markets debug app rendered a native Markets overview and BTC/USD chart using public CoinGecko data. The installed APK binary matched the local debug artifact hash in evidence; the later refreshed chart used updated local JavaScript served by Metro, so this does not establish a standalone release package.

The native BTC/USD one-week Line view showed a selected historical sample, SMA 20 and EMA 20 lines, and an RSI 14 panel. The chart, sparkline and overview carried different retrieval times, which remain separately visible.

Live PayPal/Venmo sign-in, connected wallet balances, payments, crypto trading, real Business reporting, internal staff monitoring, native iOS/tablet acceptance, and current hosted-release acceptance are not established by this pack.

In one local Xiaomi debug-app session, manual refresh returned a newer BTC/USD chart retrieval time and a 09:24 UTC sample, while the overview repeated its earlier 09:22:48 UTC retrieval timestamp and displayed the same-timestamp freshness warning.

A later Xiaomi Android 15 debug session visibly rendered the dark-mode Markets overview with a public CoinGecko BTC/USD reference and separate retrieval/provider-update timestamps. JavaScript was served over Metro; the exact runtime bundle hash was not recorded, and this is not a standalone release build.

The earlier 09:01–09:34 Xiaomi Markets captures and 6 November web/Expo Web images are historical Light-mode previews; they remain included for comparison and are not evidence of the later dark styling.

credits: PayPal and Venmo names and marks remain with their respective owners. No official affiliation, endorsement or trademark licence is claimed.
Concept cover and square social art were generated with OpenAI image_gen through Codex on 2026-11-06; the prompts and original output hashes are included. No external reference images were used.
Actual UI images are unchanged local browser/Expo Web captures dated 2026-11-06. Public market content is historical CoinGecko reference data. The Operations fixture is invented.
No official logo source, editable brand design file, font asset or licence for redistribution is included.

The earlier native Android overview and indicator captures are unchanged screenshots from a Xiaomi 22071212AG debug app, reviewed at 09:02 UTC. The additional chart-refresh screenshot was captured at 09:29 UTC after updated JavaScript was served over Metro to the same installed debug app; it was not rebuilt into the APK. The installed APK hash matched the local debug artifact, and the selected source hashes and runtime limits are recorded in the included evidence.

The dark-mode native Markets screenshot was captured on a Xiaomi Android 15 phone during a local debug session on 8 November 2026. Updated JavaScript was served by Metro from a dirty checkout based on b40086e; the exact runtime bundle hash was not recorded. The screenshot is copied unchanged and is not a standalone release-build capture.
limitations: Prepared locally; no publication, upload, submission edit or deployment is performed.
This is not an official PayPal/Venmo service. No connected wallet, live customer/staff reporting, real payment, purchase, trade or production security capability is established.
Market data and AI commentary are historical references; neither represents PayPal execution pricing, guaranteed accuracy or personal financial advice.
The source tree is uncommitted. The included captures are development previews and do not prove the current code builds or is deployed.
The new local homepage visual seen on 7 November is not an included capture. The included homepage image is explicitly historical from 6 November.

Native visual acceptance covers three Markets captures from one Xiaomi Android 15 debug-app session: overview, chart with indicators, and chart after refresh. The later refreshed JavaScript was served live over Metro and is not baked into a standalone release APK. Other app sections, iOS/tablet, release packaging and hosted behavior remain unverified by these captures.

CoinGecko overview quote retrieval was 09:00:59.060 UTC with provider update 08:59:57.000 UTC. At capture, the line chart retrieval was 08:48:12.523 UTC and the 7-day sparkline retrieval was 08:01:50.628 UTC. These timestamps show different freshness; none proves 100% accuracy or a PayPal/Venmo execution price.

The refreshed screen used an existing debug APK with updated JavaScript served live over Metro; it does not prove a rebuilt or standalone release app. A repeated overview retrieval timestamp triggered a warning and does not establish an upstream refresh or price-accuracy guarantee.

The new dark-mode capture covers only the Markets overview in one Xiaomi Android 15 debug session. Metro served the updated JavaScript; the exact bundle hash is not recorded and the APK is not a standalone release build. The web, Shop, Portfolio and Account screens were not recaptured in dark mode for this edition.
